prompts.prompt_main:
Generate a comprehensive and well-rounded overview of the following location. In your response, please include: 1. Historical and cultural context: major events, local traditions, and notable cultural influences. 2. Geographical overview: climate, topography, and any unique natural features. 3. Notable landmarks & must-see attractions: including both popular tourist spots and lesser-known gems. 4. Local cuisine & cultural experiences: typical dishes, dining etiquette, and cultural highlights (festivals, celebrations, local art, etc.). 5. Recommended activities & seasonal highlights: suggestions for different types of travelers, along with the best times of year to visit. 6. Practical travel information: transportation options, approximate costs, safety considerations, and travel tips for maximizing one’s stay. 7. Sustainable & responsible travel practices: ways visitors can minimize their environmental impact and support the local community. 8. Step-by-step directions and additional pointers: clear guidance on reaching the location from major transit hubs and any essential do’s and don’ts. **However,** your final reply must adhere **strictly** to the following HTML format (and nothing else): "

{Location name}

  • {fact1}
  • {fact2}
  • {fact3}
  • {fact4}
  • {fact5}

" **Guidelines to follow:** 1. The `

` tag should contain **only** the location name (no additional text). 2. Provide **exactly 5** concise bullet points within the `
    ` element. 3. Each bullet point should focus on a unique, interesting fact, covering the key topics above as precisely as possible. 4. **Do not** include the coordinates in your response. 5. Ensure all information is specific to the exact location. 6. Include **only** the specified HTML tags; do **not** add extra formatting or text. 7. Conclude in a way that helps travelers plan their itinerary at a glance, while still keeping each bullet point concise. [loc_type_wording]
